findings.summary: Input conversion and comment storage. A zero-width string table for an all-empty batch interacts with the pinned C-to-Fortran string allocation.

findings.summary: Original extraction outputs and persistent reader lifecycle. N0067 copies a private completion flag on early errors. Its static reader table releases entries at EOF, and a failed later-record width check can overwrite its cached physical record.
findings.repair: Use linked DAFEC with initialized logical and original row conversion. Inspect independent comment records before a short-width call, preserve its diagnostic, and drain the actual saved cursor in bounded pages only on final local close.
